user.title: Connect a Pi or Debian host
user.description: Enter the SSH connection details. The password is used only for secure bootstrap and is not retained after key setup.

confirm.title: Review and trust host
confirm.description: Detected {hostname} ({os}, {architecture}, machine ID {machine_id}). SSH fingerprint: {fingerprint}. Sudo is {sudo}. Pi Manager will {helper} the root-owned helper and restricted sudo policy.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the host over SSH.
error.host_invalid: Enter a valid hostname or IP address.
error.port_invalid: Enter a valid SSH port between 1 and 65535.
error.wrong_password: SSH authentication failed. Check the username and bootstrap password.
error.fingerprint_changed: The SSH host fingerprint changed. Review the host and explicitly reconfigure trust.
error.unsupported_os: The host is not a supported Debian/Raspberry Pi OS system.
error.unsupported_architecture: The host architecture is not supported.
error.missing_python: Python 3 was not found on the host.
error.missing_systemd: systemd was not found on the host.
error.missing_apt: apt-get was not found on the host.
error.sudo_unavailable: The SSH user cannot use the required sudo capability.
error.machine_id_unavailable: The host machine ID could not be read.
error.read_only_target: The host filesystem cannot accept the Pi Manager helper.
error.bootstrap_partial: Bootstrap stopped partway through. Retry to repair the deterministic Pi Manager files.

abort.already_configured: This remote machine is already configured.
abort.not_found: The config entry could not be found.

data.enable_dangerous_controls: Enable package changes, service restarts, reboot, and shutdown controls

error.service_invalid: One or more service names are invalid.
error.service_unavailable: A monitored service could not be validated on the host.
error.dangerous_controls_disabled: Dangerous controls are disabled for this host.
error.update_already_running: A package job is already running on this host.
error.package_job_failed: The package job failed on this host.
error.package_job_start_failed: The package job could not be started on this host.
error.package_preview_failed: The package preview could not be completed on this host.
error.package_check_failed: The package update check could not be completed on this host.
error.package_refresh_failed: The package metadata refresh failed on this host.
error.package_holds_failed: Held packages could not be inspected on this host.
error.failed_services_query_failed: Failed systemd services could not be inspected on this host.

fingerprint_changed.title: Pi Manager SSH host key changed
fingerprint_changed.description: The stored host fingerprint for config entry {entry_id} no longer matches. Connections are blocked until the host is deliberately reconfigured.

helper_incompatible.title: Pi Manager helper needs attention
helper_incompatible.description: The helper contract on config entry {entry_id} is incompatible with this integration version.
